items.html: You should also understand what was said, that when they were face to face, two phases of Jacob came out: one in ZA and one in the Nukva, for the one that is from the Mochin of ZA is from AVI, and the second, which is from the Mochin of the Nukva, is from Yisrael Saba and Tevuna, and then they are the two great lights — she is not greater than he, nor is he greater than she, and they do not need each other at all. However, the posteriors of Aba are on the right side, in Hesed of ZA, and the posteriors of Ima are on the left side, in Gevura of ZA. And this matter will be needed in its place, and there it will be explained, with the help of God.
